title: Extract workspace tab lookup helpers without changing selection behavior
outcome: Move the fifteen existing tab lookup helpers out of ui/src/workspace.ts into ui/src/workspace-tab-lookups.ts, preserving existing public workspace APIs and exact lookup behavior. This bounded slice does not complete the broader pane-routing extraction.
acceptance: Only ui/src/workspace.ts and the new ui/src/workspace-tab-lookups.ts change. Move the fifteen helpers identified in plan2be887c4a3114df882031ab06c1d0330 with unchanged signatures and bodies apart from module exports/imports; no policy, normalization, return-shape, iteration-order or object-identity changes.

The extracted module depends only on workspace-types and the existing workspace-normalize helpers; it introduces no reverse import from workspace.ts or workspace-queries.ts and no runtime dependency cycle. Public workspace exports and callers remain compatible.

Existing workspace, mailbox, Work, test-runs, response-board and pane-routing tests pass on the changed input, along with the maintained full gate including TypeScript checks. Existing test cases and assertions are not weakened or removed.
